answer: The tundra detector writes to velvet, and island makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 89 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole swarm fires them together, so that the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 139 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
